ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Over Permissive Permissions Granted Using Dsacls.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of Dsacls to grant over permissive permissions

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\dsacls\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "DSACLS\.EXE") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/G\\ .*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*GR.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GE.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GW.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*WP.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*WD.*")))
